about.title: Turkey's local incident map
about.lead: mappy.news collects accident, fire, public safety and disaster news from its sources, locates it and shows it on a map. You can always see where a story came from and follow how an incident develops.
about.sourcesTitle: Where does the news come from?

media.title: News organizations
media.text: The public RSS feeds of outlets such as Anadolu Agency, TRT Haber and NTV are checked regularly.

official.title: Official institutions
official.text: Public announcements of institutions such as AFAD, governorships and the police are followed.

readers.title: Readers
readers.text: You can report incidents around you; they are published after editors check them.

collect.title: Collect
collect.text: The news bot checks its sources and only picks up new posts.

analyse.title: Filter
analyse.text: AI decides whether a post is a local incident and summarizes it. It never invents facts.

locate.title: Locate
locate.text: Place names are placed on the map with OpenStreetMap, together with how precise they are.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate
dedupe.text: Reports of the same incident are merged and developments are added to a timeline.

review.title: Editor review
review.text: By default, nothing is published before an editor approves it.

about.precisionText: Every story is located at exact address, street, neighborhood, district or province level. For approximate stories the marker does not show the exact spot; select it to see the possible area.
about.privacyText: For sexual crimes, domestic violence and missing-person cases the location is shown at neighborhood level at most to protect the people involved. Suicide reports are not published.
about.communityText: Earn points by reporting incidents, verifying locations and commenting, and climb from Street Observer to National Hero. Points have no monetary value; they show your contribution to the community.
about.emergency: mappy.news is not an emergency service. If you witness an incident or need help, call the 112 emergency number first.

bot.description: Scans sources, uses AI to pick out local incidents, places them on the map and sends them to the review queue.
bot.offlineDescription: The bot runs as a separate process. Start `pnpm worker:dev` in development or the `worker` docker compose service on the server. Sources aren't scanned until then.

botSettings.title: Bot settings
botSettings.description: AI provider, thresholds, budget and auto-publishing rules.
botSettings.saved: Settings saved; the worker applies them within seconds.
botSettings.generalDescription: Stop the bot entirely or try it out without publishing anything.
botSettings.enabledHint: While off, the worker doesn't scan sources or call the AI.
botSettings.dryRunHint: Posts are analyzed and show up in the items list, but no stories are created.
botSettings.aiDescription: The model used for analysis and how its cost is estimated.
botSettings.missingKey: This provider's API key isn't set in the environment, so the bot can't analyze anything.
botSettings.concurrencyHint: How many posts are processed at once (1–8).
botSettings.reviewDescription: Which posts count as story candidates.
botSettings.minScoreHint: Posts below this value are rejected.
botSettings.prefilterHint: For media and community sources, posts without incident wording aren't sent to the AI.
botSettings.autoPublishDescription: By default every story waits for an editor. Auto-publishing only applies to stories that pass all of the thresholds below.

modes.offHint: Every story goes to the review queue.
modes.allHint: Every story that passes the thresholds is published without review.

botSettings.allowSensitiveHint: While off, sensitive stories always go to an editor (recommended).
botSettings.xMissing: X_BEARER_TOKEN isn't set; X sources are skipped.
botSettings.xLimitHint: X charges for every post read; once the limit is hit, X sources are skipped until the next day.
botSettings.noFallback: Only the provider you choose is used. When its credit or quota runs out the bot doesn't switch to another one; it holds the analyses and shows a warning here.
botSettings.effortHint: Higher levels are slower and cost more; low is enough to pick out incidents. On DeepSeek, low turns thinking off.
botSettings.priceHint: Picking a model from the list fills in the provider's list prices; the spend counter uses them. DeepSeek charges double at peak hours (weekdays 01–04 and 06–10 UTC).
botSettings.readArticlesHint: When a feed only carries a short teaser, the bot opens the page of each post that passed screening and reads the full text. Places and details come out far more precisely.
botSettings.autoMinPrecisionHint: Stories placed more coarsely than this (e.g. only a province) always go to an editor.
botSettings.mergeDescription: What happens when a report resembles an incident already covered.
botSettings.mergeAutoHint: When on, the AI compares a new report with similar stories from the same days: a duplicate is added as a source, a new development is attached as an update, another incident stays separate. When off, near-certain duplicates are merged by rule and the rest reaches you as a suggestion in the review queue.
botSettings.mergeMinConfidenceHint: When the AI is less sure than this its decision isn't carried out; it shows in the review queue as a suggestion with its reason.
